name: BN6's Virus Battler
now: Mapped and played on the plain ROM in romlab and in a run's game: the BtlrCard is event flag 0x1D8, each family's data a flag 0x196 + AI that BN6's "You got new Virus Data" chat sets after a rare's deletion (27 families; Mettaur and Gunner always held); battle mode 6 replaces the Custom screen by the VIRUS LIST (the V1's HP, attack and MB from 0x0802B5FC, two families at most and 50 MB), the picked placed by a cursor, then both sides fight on their own (no button but START acts), the Custom gauge their time limit (13 a frame, about 21 s): won 1, lost 2, a draw at time up 7 at BN6_BATTLE_RESULT. The five Battlers' 33 records (list 0's 0x1A-0x3A: 3, 5, 5, 10, 10 rounds of fixed V1 pairs), their series' flags, start cutscene and prizes read. In a run's game, the engine's forced battle started a mode 6 record and BN6 ran it whole; a run's own PiranhaRare registered with 0x1D8 set.
left: The design (frequency, stake, prizes by act, the card across runs: the owner's decisions); then the build: a mode 6 record of the act's pair, the held families' flags at the run's start, the series and prize in the director, the Mr.Prog's words.
